method: Run-level linearly interpolated quantiles; median of run p50s per lifecycle. Every run/block retained. Diagnostic reproducibility screen, not statistical significance or product qualification.
rule: Every run p50 within max(5% of its condition median p50, four maximum observed clock increments) of that condition median; every contiguous 600-frame block p50 within the same absolute tolerance of its own run p50. Partial blocks in smoke are identified.
classification: Prospective A/A lifecycle diagnostic only; no performance qualification
